title: BetterJob
tagline: BetterJob for Crypto Professionals is an on-chain job board on the Starknet ecosystem that provides Transparency and betetr candidate matching for users with blockchain familiarity and usage..
description:
A BetterJob for Crypto Professionals is currently geared for Crypto Professionals currently to address the problem of lack of trained professionals in this nascent field and having been conversant with the eco-system. The difference between this site and others is that it is Transparent in storing all the recruitment workflow events in the chain and how it creates a Reputation/Accreditation Score (RAS) for candidates based on their multi-modal Content for a Job Role and a BEST Match Score (BMS) for a particular Job Posting. Candidate, Organization performance scores are also stored on chain for data integrity and transparency. The chain is used for contractual agreement between organizations and platform.

Problems to solve:
➢ Employer Efficiency: Employers need to avoid being overwhelmed by irrelevant resumes.
➢ Application Customization: Tailoring resumes and cover letters to specific job postings is
time-consuming and challenging.
➢ Data Transparency: Candidate Reputation Score on chain
how_its_made:
Key Features:
Membership System:
➢ User Profiles: Individuals and organizations can create accounts and enter their basic
profile and contact information, which is securely stored in database.
Content Management:
➢ Member Content: Job seekers can upload their resumes and a two-minute introductory
audio, akin to a cover letter. Employers can post detailed job requisitions. All content is
securely stored in the database.
Data Transparency: Candidate Reputation Score on chain Blockchain:
Advanced Matching:
➢ AI-Powered Matching: The platform uses AI/ML/GPT technologies to match resumes
with job postings, generating match scores and matrices to facilitate optimal pairings.
